request.initial_prompt: Moored under the trees of Charleville Mall Father Conmee saw a turfbarge, a towhorse with pendent head, a bargeman with a hat of dirty straw seated amidships, smoking and staring at a branch of poplar above him. It was idyllic: and Father Conmee reflected on the providence of the Creator who had made turf to be in bogs whence men might dig it out and bring it to town and hamlet to make fires in the houses of poor people.

raw_segments.text: Moored under the trees of Charleville Mall Father Conmee saw a turfbarge, a towhorse with pendent head,
a bargeman with a hat of dirty straw seated amidships, smoking and staring at a branch of poplar above him.

It was idyllic, and Father Conmee reflected on the providence of the Creator who had made turf to be in bogs whence men might dig it out and bring it to town and hamlet to make fires in the houses of poor people.
